keyPoints: Carbon chaar saha-sanyojak bandh bana sakta hai — isi chatursanyojakta ke kaaran wo lakho yogik bana sakta hai, kisi aur tatva me ye kshamta nahi hai.
Carbon ke parmanu aapas me judkar lambi shringkhala, shakha wali shringkhala ya valay bana sakte hain — ise shringkhalan (catenation) kehte hain.
Hydrocarbon sirf carbon aur hydrogen ke yogik hain — methane (CH4) sabse saral hai; santript me ekal bandh aur asantript me dvi-triv bandh hote hain.
Kriyatmak samooh (functional group) yogik ke gun tay karta hai — alcohol me -OH, carboxylic acid me -COOH aur aldehyde me -CHO hota hai.
Samavayvi (isomers) ke anu-sutra same hote hain par sanrachana alag hoti hai, isiliye unke gun bhi alag hote hain.
Sabun lambe hydrocarbon shringkhala wale sodium lavan hain; unka ek sira tel se aur doosra paani se judkar mail saaf karta hai.
Aam galti: carbon ke yogik sirf jeevon me hote hain ye manna; plastic, dawa, kapde aur eendhan bhi carbon yogik hain — aadhunik jeevan inhi par tika hai.
subject: Science
title: Carbon aur Uske Yogik
